description: Decode steps of one GLM-5.3-Flash sparse-attention layer at TP4 (the serving test's tensor parallelism): R requests of one row each, run at the kernel's compiled widths 2 (R 1-2) and 8 (R 5-8); a step of fewer rows than its width carries pad rows. Contexts are AgentX decode-step-weighted quantiles (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126 rev 23f152f6, 98,827 requests; weight = tokens decoded, context = input + output / 2: p10 52K, p25 108K, p50 220K, p75 426K, p90 632K), derived from corpus statistics and not yet confirmed by a live capture. The leading request holds ctx tokens, the others ctx/2 to ctx (ragged). Every performance context is above 2051 tokens, so the index scoring and the top-512 pool selection run; short contexts, the 1M cap, odd widths and the expert-clamp range are correctness-only. Monokernel steps are decode only; prefill shapes do not apply.
